bio.text: Shawnna Bolick is a Republican member of the Arizona State Senate representing District 2; the Maricopa County Board of Supervisors appointed her to replace Steve Kaiser, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot after advancing from the July 21 primary.
She represented District 20 in the Arizona House of Representatives from 2019 to 2023.
She earned a B.A. in policy studies from Syracuse University and a master's degree from American University.

Her career experience includes working as a nonprofit professional and serving on Texas Lt. Governor Rick Perry's high-tech council, and she was appointed by Governor Doug Ducey to Arizona's Early Childhood Education and Health Board.
